learning_outcomes.text: Awareness of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Ability and skill to design and carry out experimental investigations, interpret results and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design and research and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct investigations specific to their specialty.
Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in their specialty.
Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.
Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with both engineers and people from other disciplines.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each of them, and making correct use of language, in writing.

syllabus_topics: Assembly, commissioning and testing of machines
teaching_methods: Development, writing and presentation of reports, documentation, audiovisual material related to projects/PBLs, individually or in teams
Practical work in workshops and/or laboratories, individually or in teams

assessment_methods.method: Technical capacity, involvement in project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, submitted documentation, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in proposed training activities

assessment_rules: Assessment components and their weights (70%/30% or 65%/35%) vary depending on the specific learning outcome being assessed. No resit mechanisms are available.
